thread:
maria-ml: quick dump — ran a latency sweep across us-east / us-west / eu-west comparing H100 vs A100, fp16 vs int8, and with/without the L7 edge proxy in front. p50/p95 + throughput below.

raj: nice, can you paste the p50/p95 table so we can eyeball deltas?

maria-ml: sure — raw numbers (single-run median, synthetic chat load, 8k context):
```
region    hw    config       p50(ms)  p95(ms)  throughput(tps)
us-east   H100  fp16 no-proxy   28      110       420
us-east   H100  int8 proxy      32      140       460
us-west   A100  fp16 proxy      45      210       320
eu-west   H100  int8 proxy      38      160       380
eu-west   A100  int8 no-proxy   50      230       300
```

anika: looks like the proxy adds 10-30ms on p95 for some paths — probably extra hop + TLS + occasional KV cache misses. :thinking_face:

maria-ml: yep. p95 delta seems tightly correlated with first-token KV miss rate and TCP handoff on the proxy. also kernel selection matters — switching to our optimized matmul kernel on H100 shaved ~8ms p50 vs the cuBLAS fallback.

sam-engineering: did you try a direct-pop route (bypass edge) vs edge-pop? hop count could explain the p95 tail.

maria-ml: did a quick A/B: direct->pop reduced eu-west p95 by ~20-40ms depending on backend GPU and config. throughput for A100 dropped under proxy in some mixes — looks like queueing + headroom differences.

raj: for capacity planning — if product SLO is p95 < 200ms, what node commit do you recommend?

maria-ml: rough numbers: for that workload, a single H100 node sustains ~900 tps (95th-safe) on us configs, A100 ~600 tps. factor in routing variance + warmup -> recommend 1.2–1.3x headroom. so commit = peak_qps / per_node_throughput * 1.3. example: 100k peak qps -> H100 nodes = ceil(100000 / 900 * 1.3) ≈ 145 nodes.

elaine: any quality regression from int8 quant? we need to know fallbacks for LLM chat quality.

maria-ml: small regressions on long-form prompts — ~0.7% drop on our ROUGE-like evals, token-level entropies similar. recommend gate: run targeted eval set; if any eval exceeds 1% quality loss, keep fp16 for that rollout or enable automatic fallback per-route.

raj: good. can we add these numbers to the perf dashboard and tag the curves for kernel path + proxy on the chart?

amaria-ml: yep — uploaded traces and added panels: /dashboards/latency/edge-hop-correlation?run=2423456789 (linked). charts include p50/p95 by region, kernel path annotation, and KV-miss overlay.

deploy-bot: canary: rolling 3 proxy nodes in us-west for the "edge-l7-new-matmul" config — see infra runbook.

sam-engineering: follow-ups — 1) automate routing A/B test (direct vs edge) for 48h, 2) add warmup prefetch to reduce KV misses, 3) add quant-eval to nightly pipeline. anyone object?

anika: no objections. I'll own the routing A/B.

maria-ml: I’ll add a short eval PR and update the recommendation doc. thanks all. :thumbsup:
